question: When and at which place did the Jallianwala Bagh massacre take place?
solution:
The correct answer is __**On 13 April 1919, at Amritsar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place on 13 April 1919 in Amritsar, Punjab.**
 
• **It was a brutal incident where British troops fired on a crowd of unarmed Indian civilians who had gathered in Jallianwala Bagh to protest against the arrest and deportation of two national leaders.**
 
• **The firing lasted for about 10-15 minutes, killing and injuring hundreds of people.**
 
• **The incident had a profound impact on the** **Indian independence movement and is considered one of the darkest chapters in the history of British colonialism in India.**
 
• Option 2, 3, 4 and 5 are incorrect as the Jallianwala Bagh massacre did not take place on these dates or at these places.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chauri Chaura, which is known for another incident in the Indian independence movement. On 4 February 1922, **a group of Indian protesters set fire to a police station in Chauri Chaura, killing 22 police officers. This incident led Mahatma Gandhi to call off the Non-Cooperation Movement.
 
• 13 May 1918, which is an incorrect date. There was no major incident related to the Indian independence movement on this date.
 
• 14 March 1919, which is also an incorrect date. The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place on 13 April 1919.
